theorems.name: Submission.dimred_cdg_minimizing_origin_regular
theorems.statement: ∀ (P j : ℕ), 1 ≤ j → j ≤ P → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) j, IsMinimizingIn C univ → BoundaryVanishes C → (0 : Euclid P) ∈ C.support → (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ 1 → C.massOn (ball 0 ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 + δ) * unitBallVolume j * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ j)) → (0 : Euclid P) ∈ regularSet C
